## 2. Backtest with real Kronos signals

One period = 20 trading days. Cost 0.1% per side per trade. Long-only = hold stocks with predicted 20d return > 0 (equal weight over all 30, cash otherwise). L/S = long top 5, short bottom 5 by predicted 20d return, dollar-neutral. Sharpe annualised from period returns. Mean per-period return CI is bootstrap.

| Strategy | Total return % | Ann. Sharpe | Mean period % [95% CI] | Max DD % |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Equal-weight buy & hold | 43.9 | 0.72 | 1.04 [-0.57, 2.56] | -15.6 |
| Kronos long-only | 10.6 | 0.57 | 0.27 [-0.25, 0.79] | -5.1 |
| Kronos L/S | -40.2 | -1.02 | -1.19 [-2.49, 0.03] | -42.8 |
| 5d-momentum L/S (baseline) | -33.0 | -0.95 | -0.94 [-2.01, 0.17] | -32.3 |

Cost sensitivity (total return %, per side): 0.0% / 0.1% / 0.3% / 0.5%

| Strategy | 0.0% | 0.1% | 0.3% | 0.5% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kronos long-only | 13.5 | 10.6 | 5.0 | -0.3 |
| Kronos L/S | -35.2 | -40.2 | -49.2 | -56.8 |
| 5d-momentum L/S | -27.4 | -33.0 | -43.0 | -51.6 |
